messages.subject: Particulars of Claim served - Marldale v Crayford (BL-2025-LDS-000241)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

We enclose by way of service the Claimant's Particulars of Claim, issued in the Business and Property Courts in Leeds under claim number BL-2025-LDS-000241. The Schedule of Loss is served herewith and follows separately.

We look forward to receiving the Defence in due course.

Yours faithfully

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 5500

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
